[[Category:Barbecue recipes]] [[Category:Smoked recipes]]

Please don't try to do this in the oven 'cause you'll just ruin it.

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Quart|quarts]] water
* 12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] [[Cookbook:Pickling Salt|pickling salt]]
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]
* 6–8 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] Boston [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] butt, trimmed
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* 3 tbsp dehydrated [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] peel
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]] (more if you like)
* 1 ½ tbsp dried [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]]
* 3 tbsp dark [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* Several lbs apple wood
* Hamburger buns for serving

== Procedure ==
#Combine water, salt, and honey in a 6-quart cooler. Add pork and refrigerate or place a large bag of ice on top for 8–12 hours.
#Remove pork from brine and pat dry with [[Cookbook:Paper Towel|paper towels]]. Combine remaining seasonings and rub on pork.
#Light a few chunks of apple wood and place in the firebox of a smoker. Keep temperature in smoker around 210°F.
#Place in a [[Cookbook:Smoker|smoker]] and cook for 8–12 hours, changing wood as needed. The meat should be tender at this point—if not, continue smoking.
#Let rest 1 hour, then shred with two forks. Serve on hamburger buns.
